\begin{document}
\section{Input}
A synthetic paragraph INLINE-MARK with inline math $a+b$ that is edited while formulas are typed.

A second paragraph CONVERT-MARK holds $p+q$ inline, which becomes a display.

A third paragraph EQUATION-MARK where an equation is typed key by key.

\begin{Draft}
A paragraph in a colour environment DRAFT-MARK keeps its colour.
\end{Draft}

A final paragraph REMOVE-MARK is deleted as a whole.

A tagged display TAG-MARK follows
\begin{equation} a=b \tag{$*$} \end{equation}
and the scan refuses its tag whatever is typed.

\begin{itemize}
\item a listed item ITEM-MARK
\end{itemize}

Text after the list LIST-AFTER starts its own paragraph.

A paragraph BLANKS-MARK with two blank lines after it.


Text after the blank lines BLANKS-AFTER.

Closing text after everything else CLOSING-MARK.
